meta.name: chat-layout-width-detection
meta.description: 当修复 ai-shifu 聊天页在移动端与桌面端布局判定不一致的问题时使用本技能。基于真实可见视口宽度而不是仅 `#root.clientWidth` 计算 `frameLayout`，在 `resize` 与 `visualViewport.resize` 时同步，并在断点纠正后关闭过期的移动端抽屉状态。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 修复聊天页布局在移动端与桌面端不一致的问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果聊天页在手机和电脑上布局表现不同
copy.tagline_en: Fix chat layout inconsistency between mobile and desktop
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your chat page layout differs on mobile and desktop

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会基于真实视口宽度（而非仅容器宽度）判断聊天布局是移动端还是桌面端，并在窗口大小变化时自动更新布局，同时关闭过期的移动端抽屉。
howto.when: 当修复 ai-shifu 聊天页在移动端与桌面端布局判定不一致时触发，或在窗口 resize、orientationchange、visualViewport.resize 时自动重新计算。

say.text: 帮我修复聊天页在手机和电脑上布局判断不一致的问题。
say.note: 触发布局宽度检测技能。

say.text: 调整移动端布局判定，只根据真实设备判断，不要窄窗口也算移动端。
say.note: 要求基于 user agent 判断移动端。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will determine the chat layout (mobile vs desktop) based on the real viewport width, not just the container width, and will update the layout on resize events while closing stale mobile drawer states.
howto.when_en: Triggered when fixing inconsistent layout detection between mobile and desktop on the ai-shifu chat page, or automatically on window resize, orientationchange, or visualViewport.resize.

say_en.text: Fix the chat page layout detection inconsistency between mobile and desktop.
say_en.note: Triggers the layout width detection skill.

say_en.text: Adjust mobile layout detection to only use real device, not narrow desktop window.
say_en.note: Requests user agent based mobile detection.
